## About
Elite Electrical Solution is a family owned company doing residential and commercial electrical work out of Leander. We want every customer to feel like part of the family, and we make sure the work is safe, secure and up to N.E.C. standards.
Most people rarely think about what's behind their walls until something goes wrong. If you notice anything unusual with the wiring in your Austin or Leander home, give us a call. You can send pictures and a description of the job, and we'll put together an estimate without a visit.
We're a division of Arellano Elite Construction Company LLC, and we hold a 5 rating on Google from 104 reviews.

## Services
- Electrical panel upgrades: Upgrades to your home or building's electrical panel.
- EV charging stations: Charger installs with the right wire and conduit for your charger. A reviewer said his is charging at full speed.
- Light and fan replacement: Swapping out light fixtures and ceiling fans, plus new fixtures like ceiling cans and patio lights.
- Pool and spa wiring: Wiring for pools, spas and spa installs.
- Outdoor living and kitchens: Power and lighting for pavilions, outdoor kitchens and patios.
- Parking lot and building lights: Lighting for commercial properties.
- Troubleshooting: Tracking down problems like tripping breakers and GFCI issues and getting everything working as it should.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Contact us for a free non-contact estimate.

Q: How does a non-contact estimate work?
A: Email us pictures, the address and a description of the work you need, and we'll quote it from there.

Q: Do you offer anything for veterans?
A: Yes, veterans get 10% off.

## What customers say
- "Excellent customer experience!

Had 3 jobs done with Tino and his team.
1) Install an EV charger with a 75ft run from the outside panel. Tino dropped in the proper gauge wire and conduit to use the full amperage on my 48amp charger safely and its charging at full speed!!!
2) Put our tankless hot water heater on its own circuit. The builder tied it to the outside circuit so anytime we popped the breaker due to something outside it would shut off the heater. Tino added a dedicated hot water heater circuit and even added nice printed label to the wall outlet!
3) Added a new outdoor plug and circuit dedicated to outside holiday decor. We go a little crazy with Halloween and Christmas lights and tend to usually pop the breaker so Tino added an outdoor outlet solely for holiday lighting right below the outdoor panel.

I must say that it was impressive how well Tino could draw up estimates remotely with pictures and descriptions of the work needed. I paid $75 for another electrician to come out and give me an estimate and I still went with Tino.

Extremely happy with everything! Great price, fast response, smooth transaction, excellent work, and super clean install.

We found our electrician...thanks Tino and team!" (Jeff Cortez, 5/5)
